resources.string: Add a moving picture (GIF or video)
Placing a picture: drag to move, pinch to resize
It is added on top of everything in %1$s. Move, resize, turn or delete it there like any widget.
It is added on top of everything in %1$s. Move or delete it there like any widget. Choose its size here: a moving picture cannot be resized once it is added.
The always-on display keeps every pixel of it lit, which uses more battery.
One colour by brightness: white parts take it, black and transparent parts stay as they are. Make a shape white anywhere and colour it here.
Added picture. Edits affect this variant only.
Added moving picture. Edits affect this variant only.
It was added here, so it is deleted with its artwork instead of going to the Removed list, and the face gets that space back. Undo, or add it again, to have it back.

plurals.item: %1$d is a picture added here, so it is deleted with its artwork. Undo, or add it again, to have it back.
